summary: Completed comprehensive E2E testing of Accompagn'Santé French consulting app. Backend APIs (92% success), frontend UI/UX, and admin dashboard functionality verified. Contact form integration working perfectly with real-time data flow to admin panel.

minor_bugs.issue: 404 error for category with '/' character - URL encoding issue
minor_bugs.impact: FAQ filtering by 'AT/MP' category fails on frontend

design_observations.observation: Beautiful warm beige tones with professional French design. Excellent typography with Playfair Display. UI/UX very polished.

passed_tests: Homepage loads with hero, navigation, and 4 service cards
All navigation links work (À propos, Accompagnements, Ressources, Contact)
About page accessible and loads correctly
Services page displays 6 service cards with detailed descriptions
Resources page displays 8 glossary items and FAQ tabs (AT/MP, Expertises, Assurances, MDPH)
Contact form submission works perfectly - POST /api/contact returns success
Admin login works with credentials admin@accompagn-sante.fr / Admin2024!
Admin dashboard shows contact requests with real-time stats
Contact detail modal opens/closes properly with status update functionality
Search and filtering in admin dashboard works
Authentication flow with JWT tokens working
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix FAQ category endpoint to handle '/' character in 'AT/MP' category. Consider URL encoding the category parameter or using a different character separator.
success_percentage: Backend: 92% (12/13 APIs working), Frontend: 100% (all pages and interactions working)
